{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子三命消息賦注　術數類五","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296329754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":6,"lineType":2,"content":"命書、相書之屬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"臣等謹案：珞琭子三命消息賦注二卷，宋徐","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296329754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"子平撰。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296329754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子書為言禄命者所自出，其法","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296346138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"専以人生年、月日時八字推衍吉凶禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296346138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"李","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296362522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"淑邯鄲書目謂其取琭琭如玉，珞珞如石之","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296362522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"意，而不知撰者為何人。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296362522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"朱弁曲洧舊聞云：世","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296378906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804644445519915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"傳珞琭子三命賦，不知何人所作。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296378906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"序而釋之","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296395290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以為周世子晉所為。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296395290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"然考其賦所引，有秦","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296411674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"河上公，又如懸壺化杖之事，皆後漢末壺公、","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296411674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"費長房之徒，則非周子晉明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296411674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"是書前有楚","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296428058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"頤序，又謂珞琭子者，陶宏景所自稱。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296428058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"然禄命","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296444442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"之說，至唐李虚中尚僅以年月日起算，未有","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296444442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂八字者。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296444442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"宏景之時，又安有是説乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296460826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"考其","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296477210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"書始見於宋藝文志，而晁公武讀書志亦云","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296477210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804644445536299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"宣和、建炎之間，是書始行。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296477210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"則當為北宋人所","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296493594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"作。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296493594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"舊稱某某，皆依托也。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296509978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"自宋以來，注此賦者，","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296526362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"王廷光、李同、釋曇瑩及子平四家。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296526362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"子平事蹟","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296542746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"無可考，獨命學為世所宗。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296542746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"今稱推八字為子","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296559130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"平，盖因其名。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296559130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"劉玉已瘧編曰：江湖談命者，有","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296575514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"子平，有五星。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296575514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"相傳宋有徐子平者，精於星學，","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296591898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"後世術士宗之，故稱子平。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296591898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：子平名居易，","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296608282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"五季人，與麻衣道者、陳圖南、吕洞賔俱隠華","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296608282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804644445552683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"山，盖異人也。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296608282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"今之推子平者，宋末徐彦昇，非","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296624666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"子平也。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296624666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"云云。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296641050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"其説不知何所本。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296657434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"然術家之言，","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296673818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"百無一真，亦無從而究詰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296673818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"其注久無傳本，","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296690202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"惟見於永樂大典中者，尚為完帙。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296690202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"謹採掇裒","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296706586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"輯，𨤲為上下二卷，以符宋志之舊。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296706586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"其中論運","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296722970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之向背，金木剛柔之得失，青赤父子之相","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296722970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"應，言皆近理。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296722970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"間有古法不合於今者，是則在","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296739354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"後人之善於别擇耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296739354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"又考三命通㑹亦載有","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296755738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804644445569067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子，寥寥數語，與此本絶不相合。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296755738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"盖由原","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296772122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"書散佚，談命者又依托為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296772122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"偽中之偽，盖不","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296788506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"足據，要當以此本為正也。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296788506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"乾隆四十六年三","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296804890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"7678945443296804890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣兮先天，禀清濁兮自然。","logicSentenceId":"7678958140734881792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"著三才以成𧰼，播四氣","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876191744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"以為年。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876191744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":2,"content":"元者，始也。一者，道生一冲氣也。有物混成，先天地生。以㸔命法論之，如人初受胎，月在母腹中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":11,"lineType":2,"content":"男女未分。以四柱言之，則知人本命也。尚未有生月、日、時，即貴賤夀夭未分，故云　一氣。以大道言之，則混一氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":2,"content":"而生育天地也，主祖宗之宫也。隂陽既分，清氣為天，濁氣為地。地法天，天法道，道法自然。以命術言之，則如在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":15,"lineType":2,"content":"母胎中，以是成形，男女己分也。以大道言之，天地分也。以四柱言之，則生月是也，主父母宫。天、地、人為三才。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315285979155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":19,"lineType":2,"content":"命術言之，是人生日是也，乃人身自得之宫㸔，下臨何宫分也。四氣者，布木、火、水、金以為四時，各旺七十二日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":21,"lineType":2,"content":"土旺四季，各旺十八日，故為一年五行之休旺也。以㸔命論之，是人生時也。以四柱論之，本命、生月、生日、生時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱也。每一宫有三元，有天元、人元、支元，生時主子孫也。更㸔生時天元不居休敗，居於旺相則佳矣，死囚則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"見多而晚成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"以干為禄，向背定其貧富；以支為命，詳逆順以","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876208128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"循環。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876208128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"干者，是生日天元也。㸔干下有何支，支内有何人元，而與生日天元為祿，或有禄印，或有財帛。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲生日，人甲子生旺，甲寅建禄，甲辰為財庫，甲午為妻財，甲申為官印，甲戌為財官。其甲子以水生木，如秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"生并十二月生，則有官貴命，官印無失。甲以庚辛為官印，為子有癸善制其丁，故曰癸乃甲之印綬也。更須消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"息四柱内外，吉凶輕重，而配其休祥。其言不可大疾，疾則不盡善矣。向者，要生日天元，向其禄馬也。如無禄馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315285995539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"向其財帛，或有向其壽限，向其旺相也。假令六甲生日天元，若得夏至生，而居辰戍丑未并丑位之上，則有財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"帛及有祖基。若是秋生居巳酉丑申戍四柱之內，别無丙丁，則甲之向禄也。甲以金為官印，秋生金旺，故曰向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若運到西方者，亦向禄也。運行南方及四季，亦向財也。若生月内有官印於生日天元，則主官出祖宗。如生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"月及支内有財於生日天元，則主有祖財。若生時支內有財，别無刑衝尅破，則主自立財。其論官論財，更須精","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"其休旺輕重言之，財庫並旺相為佳，官長生官庫，官旺相為妙。支者，十二支也。支内有天元十干，甲祿在寅，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"禄在卯之類，宜生日天元，取年月時中內天元，配其吉凶，或有財帛，或有官印，或壽或夭。假令甲日天元屬木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"取金為官印，取土為財帛，見丙為壽星，見乙并亥卯未為刼財，合用官印或財帛，須精休旺言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"運行","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876224512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"則一辰十嵗，折除乃三日為年。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876224512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"精休旺以為妙，窮通變","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876240896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315286011923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"以為玄。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876240896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"運行則一辰十嵗，折除乃三日為年。折除者，一年二十四氣，七十二候，命有節氣淺深，用之而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"為妙。假令六甲日生人，以金為官印，得六月下旬生，則有官印者，有祖財。更若順行陽運則為佳，逆行則運背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。甲以金為官印，南方火能奪甲之貴，南方火土之分却向財帛。若七八月尤佳。若六月上旬或中氣生，則無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"官。若年月時在申、巳、酉、丑位，更運行西方，則却有官印而亦榮顯也。若六月中氣或初氣下生，却更年與時在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、午、戌亥卯未之位，更天元有丙丁，只是商賈之命也。其五行休旺，已具前術。凡㸔命見貴賤，未可便言，且精","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱內外天元并三合有無尅奪所有之貴。假令壬午日生，乃祿馬同鄉，切不可年月時中有甲乙并寅卯。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"春生則甲乙旺土，死則壬背禄也。若夏秋生，雖見甲乙寅卯，亦有官印。夏生土旺，則官印旺也，秋生則甲乙絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"而無害。餘倣此。　假令壬子年、壬子月、丙申日、辛卯時，然丙申辛卯天地六合，被太嵗是壬子更壬子月，二壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315286028307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"刑於卯位，此合而不合也。若丙取辛作妻，定因財致禍而身災也。凡㸔命，切詳内外五行相合，有無忌神。更㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"所用者，内外天元，得淺深向背而用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"其為氣也，將來者進，功成者退，如","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876257280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇在灰，如鱔在塵。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876257280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"氣者，四時向背之氣也。假令六甲六乙生日，春生則無官，夏生則有財，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"生則向禄，冬生則生旺。秋生得申已酉丑，或壬戌、庚辰，則有官印重矣。若生時却居寅午戍已上，更有戊已丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"丁在時中，則官减半言之。如本位犯丙丁，南方火位亦奪甲之印也。五行當權者，用之為福，不當權者，用之無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"慶。假令金用火為官印，九夏生則向官，七月生則氣退，即官不遷進也。當用之神，旺相則有慶，死囚休敗則退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":85,"lineType":2,"content":"也。又如水命人，以土為官印，却得十月、正月、二月生，雖有土而不中用，以五行退，則不當權而休息。此論五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"氣退罷權之道，如蛇鱔之在灰塵，則何可長久也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"其為有也，是從無而立有；其","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876273664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315286044691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"為無也，天垂象以為文。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876273664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"此五行論於絶地而建貴也。五行絶處有禄馬，假令丁亥、丙子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"庚寅、甲申、乙酉、戊寅、壬午、癸已、已卯、已亥，皆從無天元受絶，休囚之地，却成貴强之位。鬼谷曰：干雖絶而建日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"成。鑑曰：受氣推尋，胎月須深，亦當論生日天元破絶而貴也。賦言五行窮絶處，無也；絶中建禄，則有也。凡此者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"皆合大道，貴而清也。易曰：懸象著明，莫大乎日月。日月者，天之文也，隂陽之柄也。日往則月來，暑往則寒來，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"一生造化之文也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"其為常也，立仁立義；其為事也，或見或聞。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876290048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"者，在天為五星，在地為五嶽，在人為五臟。推而行之，則為五常。常有可久之道，則秉乎仁義者。易曰：立天之道，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"曰隂與陽；立地之道，曰柔與剛；立人之道，曰仁與義。人之道，非仁與義，則不能立也。命遇金者，必要木；有木者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"須要金。是謂有剛濟柔，仁而尚勇，遇此格者多貴。賦曰金木定其剛柔是也。其為也者，今術者將人生年月日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804315286061075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"時中支，匹配吉凶作為也。或見者，年月日時上天元也。或聞者，支内人元也。甲在寅之類，又辰乃水土之庫。戍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"火庫；丑，金庫；未，木庫。辰中有乙，是春木之餘氣。未中有丁，是夏火之餘氣。戌内有辛，是秋金之餘氣。丑中有癸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"是冬水之餘氣。有春分、秋分、夏至、冬至二十四氣，七十二候，分隂陽所主之事，以定貴賤。今術者㸔命而定吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"凶，知見與不見之理，執法而善用之，則為妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"崇為寳也，竒為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876306432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"將星扶徳，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876322816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙加臨，本主休囚，行蔵汨没。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876322816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"崇者，尊也。凡㸔命主本得則成慶，并上下三元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬為竒，切忌别位嵗月時中衝尅破，本位有損，則或貴而輕也，損之重則貴而不貴也。生日厯貴地而日旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"不可擊損也，故曰崇為寳也。又如命中有掌壽、掌財、掌灾福之辰，亦不可被别位制伏，刑尅損奪，被損則有灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"禍。假令甲日生人，年月日時中庚來尅身，有乙或卯、巳、午火則能救之也。為福之地，不可被傷，禍聚之地，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140375595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"無救。三竒為貴者，謂年月日時内外三為匹配者。三竒禄馬則貴命也。更㸔祿馬所乘輕重而言之。三奇歌云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"甲巳六辛頭，乙戊向庚求。丙辛遭癸美，丁壬辛更優。戊癸逢乙妙，巳壬并甲遊。庚乙丁須聴，辛甲丙同周。壬丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"巳堪重，癸丙戊何愁。　將星者，月將也。扶徳者，徳辰也，又曰六合也。假令壬寅年、庚戌月、癸卯日、乙卯時，九月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"將在卯，扶其生日，更得九月金土六合，卯戍合，乙庚合，戊癸合，如此五行各不居休敗，則貴命也，可作兩府之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"上貴格言。雖生日取合前面貴氣，若亦本主休囚，即不為貴命也，只可作虚名言之。故曰本主休囚，行藏汨沒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"至若勾陳得位，不虧小信以成仁；真武當權，知是大","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876339200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"才而分瑞。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876339200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"勾陳，戊已土也。得位者，戊已日生臨於寅卯并亥卯位下有官印、長生、帝旺、庫墓，乃禄馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"之鄉。不虧小信以成仁者，土厚主信也，更得位則能成仁矣。此三奇貴印，即君子也，故曰以成人之美也。賦曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140391979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"約文而切埋者也。人曰真武當權者，壬癸生日也，以壬午、癸已、壬辰、壬戍、癸丑、癸未日生也。或四季月，亦是下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"有官印、禄馬、旺相墓庫而成慶，此乃作上格貴命言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"不仁不義，庚辛與甲乙交","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876355584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"差；或是或非，壬癸與丙丁相畏。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876355584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"前二句是貴命，切忌五行交差。甲已、乙庚、丙辛、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"丁壬、戊癸，是隂陽相合而成貴命也。若甲見庚、乙見辛之𩔖，皆是五行隂陽不合而交差也，乃無福之命。更有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"交差之論，且如甲以金為官印，見火而亦曰交差，則不成慶也。更有十二支交差，如午與未合，却被戌刑丑破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"卯辰破於未位，此亦曰交差。卯與戌合，而忌辰衝丑刑戍未三刑也。辰與酉合，而忌午之破為害，餘可例求焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"是者，五行和合也，成慶而貴也。非者，五行內外隂陽不起，即不是貴命也。丁畏癸，丙壬相畏故也。若丁見壬即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"為合，丙見癸即為官。一隂一陽曰道，偏隂偏陽曰疾。正合則為貴命，偏合不為貴命也。宜消息而言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876371968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140408363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"有先賢謙巳處俗，求仙崇釋則離宫修定，歸道乃水府","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876371968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"求玄。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876371968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"固有達賢之士，自謙而處俗塵，降心火而進於水府，養丹砂而成妙道矣。以㸔命言之，五行中有水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"火既濟之命也。又如丙子生人，得亥子時，或申子辰水位，亦曰既濟。假令丙申、丙辰、丙子、丁亥、丁丑、丁酉生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"或火以水相濟成慶，皆為水火既濟之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"是知五行通道，取用多門。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876388352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"理於","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876404736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"賢人，亂於不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876404736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"成於妙用，敗於不能。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876421120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"取用多門，謂人命生處，各自不同，基","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"本亦異，吉凶向背，行運用法，所主者異兆，故曰取用多門，即非一途而取軌也。亦要人用心消息五行所歸，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"知吉凶也。賢達之人，深悉造化，愚者豈能曉了？易曰茍非其人，道不虚行是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"見不見之形，無","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876437504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"時不有。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876437504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"抽不抽之緒，萬古聨綿。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876453888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"不見之形者，内天元也。庫墓餘氣節令也，衝刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140424747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"尅破也，及五行休旺，匹配生死也。三合貴地，祿馬妻財父母，皆不見之形也。只聞其有形而用之，自然應驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"凡取用法，則比蠶婦抽絲之妙。善取者能尋其頭緒，自然解之得絲也。不善者不知頭緒，萬古聨綿也。凡言命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"中貴賤吉凶，先得頭緒，則灾祥自然應驗矣。　生時坐禄，甲日見寅時，乙日見卯時之𩔖，時坐本禄，更㸔嵗月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"有無刑衝尅破本禄，禄旺用之云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"是以河公懼其七殺，宣父畏其元辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876470272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"峨眉闡以三生，無全士庶；鬼谷播其九命，約以星觀。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876486656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876503040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"集諸家之要，畧其偏見之能，是以大解曲通，妙須神悟。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876503040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"此令術者既見年月日時，取其有尅而為用者是何？作官印用之，作官鬼用之。假令甲見庚，或見申位，為官為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼，須見金木輕重之用言之。　假令丙日生人，逢亥七煞，亥中有壬，丙見壬為七煞。丁到子位，甲到申，辛到午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140441131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"壬到巳，戊到寅，巳到卯，庚到巳，皆為七煞之地，主有灾。如當生元有七煞，運更相逢，即重矣。不利求財，主有灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"如當生嵗月日時，元無七煞，則灾輕。故賦中引宣父畏以元辰者，即非前位元辰也。是當生年月日時位，元有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞害生月生時者，乃名元有元辰也，即為灾重矣。虚中云：當生元有則凶重，無則凶輕。所以宣父畏以元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"者，是宣父命中元有煞害之辰也。又戊見甲，巳見乙，為七煞。戊巳人在十月生，正月生，雖生時居巳午，或更有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛，亦夭夀。為土死不能生弱金，金囚不能勝旺木。賦云：建禄而夭夀。餘倣此。昔者峨眉先生精通三命，毎言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"貴賤，少有全者。鬼谷先生以九命之術，約以星宫為賦。此前賢自謙而言之。與物難窮，理則同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"臣出","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876519424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"自蘭野，㓜慕真風。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876519424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"入肆無懸壺之妙，遊衢無化杖之神。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876535808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"息一氣以凝神，消五行而通道。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876552192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":213,"lineType":2,"content":"臣者，太子自稱於君父前也。生於内庭，有芝蘭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140457515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"之野之稱。真風者，自㓜樂於五行之真理者也。昔有懸壺先生，貨卜於市，國君聞而召之，先生拒命而不往。君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"令執之，先生預知，以杖化龍，乘而去息。一氣者，天元也。五行者，金木水火土也。凝，聚也。消，散也。通道者，符合也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽不偏，上下符合，則能知造化，而貴賤、吉凶、夀夭定矣。猶然自謙，無化杖乘龍之為也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤立其","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876568576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"牝牡，金木定其剛柔，晝夜互為君臣，青赤時為父子。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876568576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"乾，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"物也。坤，隂物也。凡㸔命見五行，隂陽匹配，上下相合不偏者，為貴命也。若偏陽偏隂者，則五行有疾矣。金木定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"其剛柔者，且如木用金為官印，其金秋生，或帶壬癸水而尅木，即剛也。謂金旺時，水木無火，則金剛矣。若金生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"於春夏，木帶天元，人元有火，則木剛金柔也。晝陽而夜隂，陽為君，隂為臣，日月相催，晝夜相代，則互為君臣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"青赤時為父子者，丁壬合生甲巳。壬生甲，壬乃甲之母，丁乃甲之父。丁生巳，巳以壬為父，丁乃已之母。甲已再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140473899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"合，巳生辛，甲生丙，丙辛再合，丙生戊，辛生癸，戊癸再合，戊生庚，癸生乙，乙庚再合，乙生丁，庚生壬，丁壬再合，復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"生甲，已周而復始。人只知木生火，火生土，土生金，金生水，水生木，即不知隂生隂，陽生陽，陽産隂為父，隂産陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":239,"lineType":2,"content":"為母。丁乃甲之父，壬是甲之母，故云青赤時為父子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途而取軌，不可一理","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876584960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876584960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"時有冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，類恐隂䑕棲氷，神龜","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876601344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"宿火。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876601344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"假令庚辛人冬至後逢丙丁者，則為官印，謂一陽生也。金逢火之生氣，是冬逢炎熱也。夏草遭霜者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":245,"lineType":2,"content":"言丙丁人夏至後逢壬癸而得用也，謂一隂生，是火逢官之生氣，故曰夏草遭霜。又丙丁人冬至後生，雖遇七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"煞之鄉，亦作官印之用，偏隂偏陽，則有官而不清也。又庚辛人夏至雖遇巳午未寅戌，亦可作官印用，亦苦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"清。夏至後隂氣深，則為妙矣。若夏至氣淺，官雖發早，而不益壽。更詳元辰并運言之。隂䑕棲氷，如癸禄在子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140490283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"地元；神龜宿火，如戊祿在巳為人元也。丙以癸為官印，戊與癸為匹配，子與支徳六合，癸以戊為官印。須識隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"陽造化，尊𤰞逆順，戊以癸為財，丙以癸為官印。此與水火既濟之道。如冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，在學人深求之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"是以隂陽反測，志物難窮，大抵三冬暑少，九夏陽多，禍","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"福有若禎祥，術士希其八九；","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"禎祥者為應，前賢比其五行，吉凶應驗矣。如天子親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"耕曰禎祥，務天下民勤於耕種。田中種榖則生榖苗，時至七八月，則榖熟而為祥。元種豆苗，時至七八月，豆熟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"而成祥。其五榖下種各有時也，則收成也。地内曽種則望收，更有良田萬頃。不曽耕種，則遇大熟之嵗，而亦無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"可收，不得禎祥也。此論人命八字，内外元無官印，則運臨官印之地，亦不發官印，為年月日時中元無貴炁，論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"財亦論元有無也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢休敗之地，早嵗孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876617728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"老遇建旺之","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876634112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140506667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，連年偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876634112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃初㐫後吉，似源濁而流清；始吉終㐫，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876650496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"狀根甘而裔苦。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876650496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":273,"lineType":2,"content":"假令庚辛人，秋七八月生者是也。金以木為財，木絶。以火為官印，火死。早嵗孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"窮，謂生日為父母絶，則為無祖財，亦無官印，則早厯艱難也。准此。若或運臨祿馬貴官之鄉，亦多偃蹇而不成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"福。初凶者，生月凶，逢於休敗也。後吉者，生時得地也。居財旺并官印旺地，運行向所臨之位，却為有慶。止為初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"年之滯，中年晚年有福也。故曰源濁伏吟是也。若生月為鬼尅身，若生時有救，是源濁之𩔖。五行活法則度，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"遇五行交錯，但消息勝負而言之。　人命有祖財而生者，少年富貴，故云始吉。如生時不得地，或祖敗官，或身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"灾疾，更背於吉地，則為凶也。至於晚年，祖財破盡，終身困苦，雖有富貴之家，生時失地，更不得運，故曰終㐫。裔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"者，苗也，如苦物而不堪也，此先富而後貧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"觀乎萌兆，察以其元。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876666880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"根在苗先，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876683264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140523051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"實從花後。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876683264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":289,"lineType":2,"content":"欲知運内吉凶，先㸔根元勝負。根元有貴，則運臨貴地而發貴；根元有財，運臨財地而發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"財；根元有灾，則運臨灾而有灾也。貴賤吉凶，自有根苗，則無不結實而應驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"胎生元命，三獸","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876699648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"定其門宗；律吕宫商，五虎論其成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876699648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"胎生元命者，乃人之年月日時所得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"天元、人元、支元也。三獸者，寅午戍之𩔖是也。門宗者，一𩔖也，如寅午戍火之𩔖。五虎者，支也，持大運逆順生日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"向背数而行之。假令甲寅生午逢庚戌也，亦曰鬼庚戌見丙午之𩔖。賦曰：五虎者，以寅為首也，此乃五陽相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"也。論其成敗者，有救而身旺則成，無救而身衰則敗也。好事者宜精詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"無合有合，後學難","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876716032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"知。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876716032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"得一分三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876732416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"無合者，年月時中，取財而無財，取貴而不貴，取合而不合，𠔥之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"以根在苗先，實從花後，此乃八字内有根而方發苗。又云禍福者，然八字内外無合，而有合在别位之内，内外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140539435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"五行刑衝尅破，於别位之禄停住不得，至令飛走三合，就於本命生日相合，或寅刑巳內丙戊巳酉丑，三合就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"走馬。假令甲子年、丙寅月、癸丑日、辛酉時，若論官則背禄而不貧，以八字内外三元無戊，𠔥正月土死，其背禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"明矣。却被寅刑巳，丑破巳，甲子遥尅於巳，而巳内有丙戊被刑破，破而飛走出巳，三合就馬，已酉丑月三合，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"就辛酉，戊就癸丑而合癸，癸以戊為官印，此乃無合有合也，故後學難知，誠也，信也。古人歌曰：虎生奔巳猪猴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"定，羊擊猪蛇自然榮。　無合有合歌：飛禄飛來就馬騎，資財官職兩相宜，王中更得本家助，上格榮華富貴奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"人歌：志節二八亷貞女，四面猪猴獰似虎。先㸔天元乘地馬，後邊集路教侵取。　得一者，既見有寅刑已，丑破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"巳，而丙戊被刑破而出，則便分三而行。既得已位為用，便是三合已酉丑也。須有酉丑上有癸辛字，則為有合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"之命。雖刑而禄出，無合則不佳也。前賢者，為賦以前賢人也。立此　一訣之門，後作賦者又指説得一合、三合見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140555819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"頭緒，而作三合取吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘灾。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876748800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"運初至於衰鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876765184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"猶披尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876765184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"此言冠帶大運也。假令庚辛日人，初年無祖財，又自戊酉逆行，皆厯無財敗禄之運。喜逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"未運，是財旺之地，只可言方入禄運，漸向泰也。只言從此運後，所求遂意，後五年方有三五分福也。運氣淺深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"而言之，淺則福淺，深則福厚也。庚辛見未為冠帶，縁運自西方而來，久閑於財禄，故有尚有餘灾也。　言先厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"貴旺之鄉，或建財之地，已成大器，而方交入敗宫失財之地，未可作大敗之運言之，只可言自入此運，不甚遂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"意。謂前運久厯貴强之地，根基極厚，雖臨敗運，未至大損，故初運入衰鄉，猶披尠福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"大叚天元","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876781568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"羸弱，宫吉不及以為榮。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876781568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"中下興隆，卦凶不能成其咎。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876797952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"天元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"者，干也。雖臨禄馬之地，若天元被傷，而本炁羸弱，則亦不能為榮。假令壬午人，四月生，更别位戊已相尅，貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140572203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"不貴也，可作虚名及無禄言之。然壬午宫吉，而天元無氣，更加重重戊巳來尅，故名不貴矣。又云不及者，上下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"五行休旺不相負也。又如庚辛日人，正月生，更别位有重重火相尅於金，其金見寅卯甲乙，而亦無祖財，一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"煎熬，遇財鄉反成禍而身灾也。金春生尅木為財，而木中旺火，必害其金而成灾，此亦是天元羸弱，而宫内有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"財，不得而發矣。其餘五行倣此言之。　中者，人元也。下者，支元也。假令十月壬建，其禄亥乃水之旺鄉，此乃中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"下興隆也。若丁亥日人十月生，乃火絶於亥，其丁生絶地，乃為丁卦之㐫也。不能成其咎者，謂丁以壬為官印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"而中下禄馬建旺而成慶，雖火臨絶地，尚為中下之貴。成鑑曰：禄雖絶而建貴是也。陶朱云：絶禄亡財，不為凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"兆也。丙人十　一月生，壬癸人十二月生，并辰戍丑未金人正月生，木人七八月生，土人亥卯未月生，皆臨貴旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"之地，謂消息也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇尊㐫𤰞吉，救療無功。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876814336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"尊吉𤰞㐫，逢灾自愈。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876830720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140588587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"禄有三㑹，灾有五期。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876847104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"尊者，年月日時，内外三元，有最得力者是也。賦云崇為寳也，尊也。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"令六甲生人，以庚及申為之七煞，若大運則庚及申為禄絶之鄉，致身灾也，所為不能遂心。又如甲乙以庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"為官，大運至巳午，又見寅午戍是也。神得氣定，甲乙失官也。若甲乙人秋生，甲以辛為官，乙以庚為官，或二木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"用申為官，此乃鬼旺之鄉，甲木全藉乙木，或亥卯未為救。若遇行年太嵗尅木，或火運有害乙木之官，使甲被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":370,"lineType":2,"content":"尅，㐫也。元本甲藉頼乙配於庚，次用庚為偏官。若乙被害，則甲亦凶也。所謂𦂳用之者，不可受害也。乙既被害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":372,"lineType":2,"content":"則甲天元醫療無功也。五行為主者，病重而不能救也。若年月日時，内外三元，雖有尅戰，而但不損外尊者，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":374,"lineType":2,"content":"逢灾自愈也。更切消息所損之神，主何貴賤而言之。害命則身灾，害妻則妻灾，害官則失官，與行年不和，則主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"上位不喜，不宜干上位。若衝擊行年嵗君，則主有不測官訟，小人横事不足，或主身病，故曰尊凶也。　假令甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140604971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":380,"lineType":2,"content":"乙以巳、酉、丑、申、子、辰為禄，甲以巳、酉、丑為禄，即三㑹也。乙為五期之灾。乙以申、子、辰三㑹為有禄之命。大運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":382,"lineType":2,"content":"於官郷，更行年太嵗是三會之年，與本命位主本相生，會於禄馬，則此年定遷官進禄也。若太嵗本命八字及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":384,"lineType":2,"content":"大運内外不合，更大運在鬼旺之鄉，五期之嵗定作灾矣。更精所生向背言之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫多吉少，𩔖大","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876863488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"過之初爻；福淺禍深，喻同人之九五。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876863488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":386,"lineType":2,"content":"此兩卦卦爻，以此人命四柱之中，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":388,"lineType":2,"content":"元内外，元無貴氣者，更運背禄馬，則為凶可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，是六甲之虧盈。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876879872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"當","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876896256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"憂不憂，頼五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876896256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":390,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲乙用庚辛為官印，乃為喜也。却正月、二月、五月、十一月生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":392,"lineType":2,"content":"雖見金而無官印，謂正月庚絶，二月受氣，五月金囚，十月金病，十一月金死，故曰聞喜不喜。當憂不憂者，如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":394,"lineType":2,"content":"人見庚，或甲在七煞之地，如年月日時中有乙或有卯字，或甲春生，或三位内有丙丁火多𦔳，為不憂也。乙為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140621355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":398,"lineType":2,"content":"合庚夫，庚親甲為妻之兄也。若無乙有卯亦得。若十月、十一月生，雖有丙丁亦不能為用，謂火無氣不能尅金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":400,"lineType":2,"content":"若無乙字、卯字，即用為憂也。其餘准此。　假令六甲生人，以辛為官，三春九夏，庚辛囚休，雖見中酉之位，并庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":402,"lineType":2,"content":"辛而不成慶也，謂金囚故也。春生甲日則尅妻無財，無妻一生少病。三月生則為財庫，夏生則有父母財。嵗時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":404,"lineType":2,"content":"有亥子，則為甲之生旺，有辰戌丑未為財帛，有申酉之位則好學，有始無終。更㸔運行逆順向背，如向遇鬼尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":406,"lineType":2,"content":"則横發官資，運背則逢財擊運而不發，逢金亦不發。官謂金土，元居休敗，故不獲福。　假令乙生人，以庚為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":408,"lineType":2,"content":"印，春夏生無官，正四月尅庚最重。乙以土為財，春正二月上死無財，三月為乙之財庫，有祖財。然申為學堂，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":410,"lineType":2,"content":"有始無終，皆謂金休敗。又如乙見庚為官，雖嵗時位内有庚金，或有申酉之金，若見天元有丙，則亦無官，此乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":412,"lineType":2,"content":"見庚而不用，乃聞喜不喜之謂也。乙若四月生時居亥子或申子時水鄉，則却有禄，謂四月是金之長生也，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140637739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":416,"lineType":2,"content":"乙遇官之長生，𠔥有水鄉制其火而成慶亦不清。如胡茂老，丁卯年、庚戌月、戊寅日、癸亥時，九月二十八日生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":418,"lineType":2,"content":"八嵗八箇月退運，節氣極深，起運將年月日時節氣向背，乃上下三元匹配，有兩三竒，八字俱無一字閑，皆禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":420,"lineType":2,"content":"馬同鄉，不三台而八座。以運臨乙巳，被當生癸亥衝擊，大運并刑，提綱而罷權也。賦云：與生地之相逢，宜退身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":422,"lineType":2,"content":"而避位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤臨於五墓，戌未東行，六虛下於空亡，自乾南","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876912640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"首，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876912640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":424,"lineType":2,"content":"乾在戌亥之間，假令甲子旬中，戌亥空亡也。戍未東行者，戌東行見丑，未東行見辰。如見生命内八字三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":426,"lineType":2,"content":"元上下居於辰戌丑未支内。人元被破而支虚，則　一生孤立少骨肉，或為僧道遊走入舎之命。其於福氣可詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":428,"lineType":2,"content":"所稟之氣，察夫命向背言之為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"天元一氣，定侯伯之遷榮。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876912640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"支作人元，","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876929024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"運商徒而得失。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876929024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":430,"lineType":2,"content":"天元者，十干也。支者，十二支也。定侯伯之遷榮者，將為主，天元配其人元，而定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140654123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":434,"lineType":2,"content":"其吉凶貴賤也。支作人元者，令好事者八字內外五行作為也。運商徒而得失，㸔見支下有財無財。賦意令㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":436,"lineType":2,"content":"命者，先㸔其有官印髙低，有者。次㸔財命如何，有財則得財，無財則失財。如得大運，即將為主天元循環而推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":438,"lineType":2,"content":"之，每交一運，先㸔運下有何吉凶，次㸔運命八字元有何吉凶。元有官則發官，元有財則發財，有灾則發灾。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":440,"lineType":2,"content":"當生年氣深，則迎運前發其灾福，中氣則主中停。如氣淺，則所居欲交前運，而方發灾福。更㸔逐年太嵗如何，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":442,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云：根在苗先，實從花後。宜消息言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"但㸔財命有氣，逢背禄而不貧。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876945408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876961792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"也財絶命衰，縱建禄而不富。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876961792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":444,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬癸人生在三春，或見寅午戌，而八字内外或有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":446,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙二字，即背禄矣。壬癸以戊已為官印，被甲乙寅卯尅奪去官印，即無官也。唯有水尅火為財，春生火旺，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":448,"lineType":2,"content":"曰財命有氣也。十干背禄，甲乙日生見丙丁，丙丁見戊巳，戊已見庚辛，庚辛見壬癸，壬癸見甲乙，見之背禄無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140670507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":452,"lineType":2,"content":"疑。假令生日是甲，嵗月時上有丙，下若居巳午，皆背禄，以辛為官，辛是丙之妻，丁之正財，自然奪辛金。甲禄既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":454,"lineType":2,"content":"背於丙丁，却有戊已，甲可取戊已為妻財而為福矣。賦云背禄而不貧也。更須精五行休旺居攴干方位，併休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":456,"lineType":2,"content":"旺矣。建禄不富六甲人正月生，逢丙寅，是生月建禄也。甲禄在寅，故曰建禄而不富也。正月土病，甲以戊已為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":458,"lineType":2,"content":"財，寅卯乃土病之地，雖建甲之正禄旺而無祖也。生月為父母，故無祖財也。死妻多數而孤。若嵗時位内有亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":460,"lineType":2,"content":"卯未，或有乙干，故三妻之上，主一世貧窮，作事多虚詐，為人大様。或論官則名目而已。權印極輕謂無金，只見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":462,"lineType":2,"content":"甲之本禄而春生，則一生少病。若當生嵗時，得辛未、癸未、癸酉、辛亥、戌丑則佳。然金土本主休囚，頼於金土分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":464,"lineType":2,"content":"野，為官印、為財，如得此嵗，扶小慶之命，大運遇巳、酉、丑位，則官印、財帛奮發，而亦不崇顯也謂金土絶死賦云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":466,"lineType":2,"content":"根在苗先，實從花後故也。若當生嵗時，位內無金土之貴，則遇金土而不發官印、財帛也。謂嵗時月内外元無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140686891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"金土之貴，則遇吉運而亦不發福謂主本元無也。故云福星臨而禍發，以表㐫人謂運臨貴地而不發福，以表","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"當生嵗時，所稟富貴極厚，而運臨刼財、七煞之地，雖敗財敗官，亦自有喜，謂所乘福氣之厚也。　　六乙人，二月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":474,"lineType":2,"content":"生是也。若嵗時位内有申并巳、酉、丑，則官印稍得為用，至輕也。如嵗時位內天元有庚，則尤佳。嵗時若居辰、戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"巳上，則為乙之財，亦妙矣。丑為貴地，財官兩美。若月時位内有亥、卯、未，或更别位天元上見甲、乙或寅位，則一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"生財帛不聚，尅三妻以上，亦無祖財，為性好剛，亦平生少病，謂木春生而身旺鬼絶也。三月金方受胎，雖破命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":480,"lineType":2,"content":"而長年也。乙夘以辛或酉為七煞，以春生金絶運，逢金為財庫，巳為背禄而有財，午未見財，多而不成。成鑑曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"絶破皆空，五行支枯也。逢申運則財發官得權，凡百遂意。若當生嵗時，元有申位，則依前申寅篇内究之，其五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":484,"lineType":2,"content":"行活法，未見嵗時分野之氣，亦未可一途而取軌也。六丙人，四月生是也。四月水絶，若嵗時得癸亥、壬子、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140703275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"戍、癸卯、甲子，則官稍得，此亦鬼絶，而用鬼為官印，然不清，亦可作有用之命，然一生坎坷，若嵗時内無壬癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":490,"lineType":2,"content":"子，則是建丙火本家禄主之命。論六甲乙之命言之，亦無祖財，若臨午未，則妻死三數一生無財禄，出軍班吏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":492,"lineType":2,"content":"人，名目極卑。　六丁人，五月生是也。謂丁禄在午，丁以庚辛為財，五月金休敗，無祖財，或因主尅妻，若嵗時有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":494,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子申、辰水，則為官用，然名目不清，亦且入仕向，武臣止大使臣，文官止京朝而巳。若嵗時居巳戌，或干頭有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"戊巳土，則名目而巳。權印禄輕，情性動作亦同甲乙，皆是建旺，本禄五行，别無造化，而不君子也。　　六巳人五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":498,"lineType":2,"content":"月生是也。謂巳禄在午，巳以壬癸為財，五月以水囚，無祖財也。尅妻三數，子見而不立，運逢財而不聚，作事厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":500,"lineType":2,"content":"而有理，性好静可言語。若嵗時內有甲有寅，則為正官，為福亦妙。有亥卯未，則為偏官。干頭有乙，則為鬼，而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":502,"lineType":2,"content":"尅身，謂甲乙夏死，身旺鬼絶也。以甲為官，亦嫌木死而官卑，如嵗時辛亥、庚子、癸丑，或申、子辰，則財但得，亦無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140719659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":506,"lineType":2,"content":"大富也。　六戊人四月生是也。謂戊禄在巳，戊以壬癸為財，四月水絶，無財尅妻，見子多而不立，致有絶嗣。戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":508,"lineType":2,"content":"雖旺而鬼死，謂之偏易也。故賦云：眷屬憂其死絶。若嵗時居申子辰水位，則子晚見而不絶也。止有一數，餘同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":510,"lineType":2,"content":"上論。　　六庚人，七月生是也。謂庚禄在申。論官則建庚之干禄。金以木為財，七月木絶。若上旬生，則有祖財。謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":512,"lineType":2,"content":"有六月金氣。未為木庫，雖臨木絶之鄉，以七月氣而尚有三五分庫財之福也。運至酉戍，破盡也。酉戌乃庚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":514,"lineType":2,"content":"刼財，故賦云：小盈大虧，恐是刼財之地。加以戌刑未，祖財所以破盡也。若中旬末旬生，則無財也。或嵗時居寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":516,"lineType":2,"content":"卯并亥未，則生財而亦不廣。若太嵗臨於酉戍，又無財也。若嵗時干有丙丁，居於東南之位，亦為官印。若嵗時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":518,"lineType":2,"content":"支并，却有壬癸，則無官也。若嵗時居巳午，更兩位干是戊巳，則有官禄而不清不顯，以秋火無氣故也。陶朱云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":520,"lineType":2,"content":"若逢天元㑹例，遇鬼，則父子不親。壬癸時，庚辛為母，以丙丁為妻，被水尅去丙丁，所以庚辛背禄也。運行午火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140736043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":524,"lineType":2,"content":"旺之地，亦發福，則只是暫得時，而巳終不成大𠾖也。六辛人，八月生是也。建禄臨官，財印一依六庚同論。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":526,"lineType":2,"content":"辛亥、辛卯、辛未，財則不闕，亦無大積。未為辛之財庫，卯為辛之財鄉，亥為辛之財長生，皆為支内支財也。以八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"月財絶命衰，縱建禄而不富也。此三辛財且薄，其餘皆依庚論。如庚申、辛酉、辛丑，吉凶之論。如辛巳時有貴，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"有官印亦輕。　六壬人十月生是也。壬以丙丁為財，十月火絶，以戊巳土絶。賦云巳巳戊辰，度乾宫而脱厄是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"也。常術以水土絶於四月，其水固絶土，非也。土絶在亥，故以十一月生，人運到亥為厄運也。其壬十月無土無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":534,"lineType":2,"content":"火，乃財絶命衰也。壬亦以戊巳為鬼，十月戊巳絶。假令嵗時位有戊巳，或戌丑未可作官印用，亦不為鬼。賦云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年是也。　　六癸人十　一月生是也。癸禄居子，論財、論官印、論鬼，亦依干禄倣言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年；鬼旺身衰，逢建命而夭","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876978176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140752427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"壽。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876978176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":542,"lineType":2,"content":"身旺者，甲人正月生，甲以金庚為鬼，即可為學堂之用，不可作鬼，謂之庚鬼，自然絶而不能害其甲，雖破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":544,"lineType":2,"content":"命而長年也。又經云：身衰者，如甲人秋生，秋金旺，乃甲木絶，甲雖逢寅卯建禄之地，與庚金相逢，雖則重重之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":546,"lineType":2,"content":"救，必夭夀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄逐馬，守窮途而悽惶。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448876994560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬同鄉，不三台而","logicSentenceId":"7678958448877010944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"八座。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448877010944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":548,"lineType":2,"content":"如六甲人生在三春九夏，天元更帶丙丁，則背禄也。逐馬者，甲逢乙或亥卯木尅，逐馬也。甲以金為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":550,"lineType":2,"content":"官印，春金絶，夏金囚，更嵗月時中帶天元丙丁，則甲背禄。甲以巳土為財、為馬、為妻，被乙并亥卯木尅，逐去巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":552,"lineType":2,"content":"土，則甲無財而無官，必尅妻也。故云餘皆依此推之。假令壬午生，下有丁巳是三奇禄馬同鄉，更要生時，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":554,"lineType":2,"content":"在休敗。如得庚午時，則時中庚自坐禄，以庚制其甲，以辛制其乙，使壬存已土，即禄重也，無失而早發矣。若壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":556,"lineType":2,"content":"午日得壬寅月時，則背禄也。謂寅中有甲木奪已土，即壬無官也。寅中却有火生，則依上論，如冬生則减半言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140768811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"之。秋生却有禄，謂木絶不能奪土，秋土懐金，金生壬生癸，木絶火死，所有以不能尅土。若嵗月時中有亥卯，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":562,"lineType":2,"content":"亦能破巳土，卯亦破午。如嵗月時中無争奪衝刑隳壊，則貴可定兩府，更切精休旺言之為妙。賦云禄馬同鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":564,"lineType":2,"content":"不三台而八座是也。若有為害之位，更精為害之休旺，量力而言。成鑑云：更須四被無侵，多獲吉慶。云無全士","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"庶為百全之命也。謂如太宰唐公命丙午年、庚子月、壬午日丙午時，何謂貴？謂壬午日幹起丙午上丙字來尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":568,"lineType":2,"content":"子上庚字，上庚既被丙來尅，則避丙却於午位。壬字乃庚之子，再得丙午時，丙又不與，壬位又來子位，二丙在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":570,"lineType":2,"content":"子，皆為丙䑕，兩丙皆厯貴地。賦云歸道乃水府求元，皆是丙癸造化也。庚壬居干，又是三奇禄馬同鄉，此云飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":572,"lineType":2,"content":"天䘵馬也。天元動作出入，惟十二支辰不動，為屬地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇禄顯，定知夹禄之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448877027328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"小盈大虧，恐是刼財之地。","logicSentenceId":"7678958448877043712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":574,"lineType":2,"content":"論夹祿：戊辰日、戊午時、丁巳日、丁未時、巳未日、已巳時、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140785195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":578,"lineType":2,"content":"戌日、壬子時、癸丑日、癸亥時。凡見夹禄者，不可本禄上有嵗月所占，占了則官實也。實則不容物也，官不崇顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":580,"lineType":2,"content":"也。其禄比盛物之器，空則容物有禄占非真夹禄也。假令宋景陽郎中命庚午年、丁亥月、已未日、已巳時，兩已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":582,"lineType":2,"content":"夾午中之禄也，却不合庚午太嵗實了午位，又十月衝動巳已夾禄不稳，即不至清顯也。如此之命，華而不實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":584,"lineType":2,"content":"也。凡見夹禄不稳，徒有虚聲耳，不可作夾禄論之。　假如王中命甲寅日、甲子時，二甲夾丑，丑乃金庫之鄉，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":586,"lineType":2,"content":"甲之貴地。公運行辛丑，除通判。丑運足而交庚子，被大運庚子尅了子上甲字，乃夾禄不住，走了貴炁，一旦壊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":588,"lineType":2,"content":"盡。所以福聚之地，不可被傷，福聚之地，不可無救。其餘夾禄、夾貴倣此。　戊見已，庚見辛、壬見癸，皆為刼財，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":590,"lineType":2,"content":"甲見乙同。前五陽見五隂，為刼財，尅妻。後五隂見五陽，敗財不尅妻，防隂賊或小人相侵。乙以甲為親，兄以戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":592,"lineType":2,"content":"已為財，甲能奪巳壊戊。丁以丙為兄，丁以庚辛為財，丙能奪辛為妻，破庚。已見戊為兄，已以壬癸為財，戊能奪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638805281140801579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"癸為妻，破壬。辛以庚為兄，辛以甲乙為財，庚奪乙為妻，破甲。癸見壬為兄，癸以丙丁為財，壬奪丁為妻，破丙。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":598,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲奪乙財是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"生月帶禄入仕，居赫奕之尊重犯竒儀藴藉，抱出羣之","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310904354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"器","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310904354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":2,"content":"世。術用六甲人正月生者，此名建禄而不富，此非生月帶官禄也。生月帶官禄者，如甲乙人秋生，丙丁人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":2,"content":"冬生，戊巳人春生，庚辛人夏生，壬癸人生於四季月是也。且如甲乙木，用金為官禄也。庚金旺，是生月帯官禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":2,"content":"也。遇之者，官禄超遷，功名特達也。或問曰：此生月帯禄而為福者，尋常有之，而賦意言之何重也？荅曰：如賦云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":2,"content":"略之為定一端，究之翻成萬緒是也。如甲戌人，八月生建酉，酉中建辛，辛為甲之旺官禄。若當生嵗時，居寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637704747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":19,"lineType":2,"content":"戍火局，更别位有丙丁火，亦不能損甲之官禄，以八月火死故也。或當生嵗時，居亥卯未木局，更或别位有甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":21,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木，亦不能奪甲之財帛，以八月木絶故也。有火不能損官禄，有木不能刼財帛，是財官兩喜，為赫奕之尊，固","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":23,"lineType":2,"content":"其宜也。凡命中帯禄者，禄出祖上，又不如生月帯禄者，則父子之氣近，為禄相須也。更有生日支内，天元自旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"生時不居休敗者，復更行運在禄鄉，如此之命，又何啻居赫奕之尊，是三台八座之格，應貴人之命子，又何疑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"焉。賦云根在苗先，正此意也。竒者，三竒官印也。遇之者，有威儀之貴也。藴藉者，三元内外，嵗月生時，藏蓄五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"括囊造化，貴氣往還，無諸刑戰。如此之命，出乎其𩔖，為大器之貴命也。且如向公安撫命，戊寅年、甲子月、乙丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":31,"lineType":2,"content":"日、庚辰時，何以為貴？戊以乙為官印，乙丑自居官鄉，乙見戊為偏官，戊居寅為禄位。又見庚辰時，乙丑見庚為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":33,"lineType":2,"content":"官印，庚自居辰，辰中有乙為財帛。乙丑六合，甲子月，是乙見䑕貴，則知宗族貴家，是名乙戊向庚為三竒之貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637721131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"也。不惟只此，而又金土之氣堅潤，十　一月生，五行藏蓄，唯忌逢火。其時火死水旺，三任方靣，可應出羣之器，餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"可例求焉。此賦論貴命根基，此以後説運中會遇也。故下文云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女，時觀出入之","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310904354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"年；隂女陽男，更㸔元辰之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310904354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"假令隂命男，三月下旬生，得節氣深，八嵗運，乙酉年、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰月、乙丑日、辛巳時。乙木下取丑中金庫為官印。又三月氣深，時迎初夏，又得辛已時，當生年乙酉，三合已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑，丑位不背官印，三月氣深，木向衰病，金向長生。賦云向背定其貧富是也。又曰將來者進。三十八嵗運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":47,"lineType":2,"content":"丁丑，則財官兩美。賦云每見貴人食禄，無非禄馬之鄉是也。三十九嵗交丙子運，是謂出入之年也。且乙用庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"為官印，見丙乃庚之七煞，當生年三月氣深，向丙不逺。又大運丙子，子與巳合，合起巳中丙。丙尅妻則乙損官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":51,"lineType":2,"content":"乙以庚為妻，則灾妻損財。更或值丙、丁、巳、午年，則㐫。此是出入之年，為㐫可知也。時觀者，是當生年中四時之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637737515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"時也。賦云一旬之內，於年中而問千；一嵗之中，於月中而問日是也。此年運交，出入，當時迎氣深。又辛巳時中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"有丙，初交丙子運，則灾損自應也。賦云隂男陽女，便是隂女陽男也。前云出入之年，此論元辰之嵗，其理無二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"也。前論乙丑日，陽命男運出丁丑，欲入丙子，此亦是行來出入，抵犯㐫方之義。前説三月深向丙丁之氣不逺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"運入丙子，則失官財、損妻灾。况在四月三五日生，作三嵗運，是當生元，有害官印之辰，賦云宣父畏以元辰是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"也。其或更值寅、午、戌年、巳、未太嵗，是名元辰之嵗，則救療無功也，便當生嵗。時中有壬癸小運在申子辰，亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"濟事，四月水絶故也。大率所犯有傷，不可救也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"與生地之相逢，宜退身而避位。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310920738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"凶㑹吉㑹，伏吟反吟，隂錯陽差，天衝地擊。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310937122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"生者，生旺也。凡五行𣅜不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"宜生旺。隂陽書云：金剛火强，自刑其方。木落歸本，水流趍末，則為自刑之刑也。且以庚辛言之，則金也旺於西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637753899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":73,"lineType":2,"content":"方，故庚禄在申，辛禄在酉。如庚辛生人運到申酉，則宜退身避位也。夫何故？庚辛用丙丁火為官印，火至申酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":75,"lineType":2,"content":"則病死，則庚辛無官也。庚辛尅甲乙為財帛，木到申酉則死絶，則庚辛無財也。官財俱衰，雖建祿而不富。故云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"與生地之相逢，宜退身而避位。鬼谷曰：金降自乾東而震西南，遇坤鄉而敗禄衰官，正此意也。賦意幽妙，宜深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"識之。此説運中造為引問發明之辭，如上文云出入之年，皆吉凶兩存而不辨。在學人曉而合之，上下貫穿而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"得其辭悟矣。伏吟者，大運與元命相對者是也。以衆術言則不佳，以賦意言之，其間亦有凶㑹吉㑹存焉。錯者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":83,"lineType":2,"content":"錯雜也。差者，交差也。人命有隂陽錯雜，人運亦有隂陽交差，多為灾損。如元命與運在東南，而遇太嵗西北者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":85,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之天衝。元命與運在西北，而太嵗在東南者，謂之地擊。大槩與隂陽差錯不殊，然不能無别焉。西北衝東南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"者，主動攺出入，是内衝外也。東南衝西北者，雖衝而不動，是外衝内也。遇此者，皆主不寧，其間吉凶兩存。詳而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637770283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"言之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢四煞五鬼、六害、七傷、地網天羅、三元、九宫，福臻","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310953506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"成慶，禍併危疑，扶兮速速，抑乃遲遲。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310953506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"如元命犯辰、戌丑、未在四柱中，或大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"運又行到，或辰戌丑未之上者，謂之四煞。五鬼，如大運干為鬼制，財尅官印，此五行之鬼也，與太嵗同。六害者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":97,"lineType":2,"content":"且如丑未生人，四柱中復有丑未，更大運在辰戌丑未之上，却遇太嵗在子午卯酉者，謂之六害，遇之者主骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"肉分離。七傷者，運中逢七煞是也。如甲乙日生人，用庚辛為官印，運在南方，或逢寅、午、戌、巳與未，太嵗是也。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"煞輕，五鬼重，六害輕，七傷重，運逢之輕，嵗遇之重。地網天羅者，戍人不得見亥，亥人不得見戌，謂之正天羅。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":103,"lineType":2,"content":"人不得見巳，巳人不得見辰，謂之真地網。遇之者灾病連綿，不獨嵗運忌逢之，四柱中亦不宜也。三元者，日干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"為天元，支為地元，納音為人元，即三元九宫也。假令戊寅年、壬戌月、甲申日、巳巳時，陽男命氣淺，八嵗運甲，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804215637786667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":109,"lineType":2,"content":"金為官印，九月生，是生月帯禄也。二十六嵗小運至辛丑，大運乙丑，二運幷在官禄財庫之上，未可言凶，此名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"吉㑹，故曰福臻，則乃成慶也。又如乙酉年、癸未月、庚戍日、甲申時，隂男命氣深，九嵗運逆行，以生日庚戍下取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":113,"lineType":2,"content":"火庫為官印，又六月生，亦是生月帶禄也。三十九嵗大運到庚辰，乙庚合小運甲辰，併天地六合之上，未可言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"吉也。以當生六月氣深，運到庚辰，辰衝戌，辰乃水庫，水尅火，三合甲申水長生兩辰衝戍破官印，則為凶會，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":117,"lineType":2,"content":"曰禍倂，是乃危疑也。扶兮速速者，如前戊寅年以甲申為主，運到乙丑者，或遇行年太嵗三合，合上扶同相助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteId
