List":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"則為吉慶而速速也。扶助也。若太嵗無刑，或相衝相害，則是與氣運相抑，抑，不順也，是乃發福遲遲也。大凡推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"運，須㸔生年太嵗與運生尅，生尅巳定，則吉凶無不應驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"厯貴地而待時，遇比肩","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310969890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"而爭競。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310969890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"至若人疲馬劣，猶託財旺之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7678982009310986274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":123,"lineType":2,"content":"生日臨官印之貴，是厯貴權之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511573540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"地。且如壬辰癸巳日，用土為官印，用火為財帛。若生月不居九夏，不在四季，則是虚聲之命，雖厯貴地，而猶待","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"於四時，基本元有元無也。遇比肩而爭競者，如壬辰癸巳生人，更生九夏四季，得其官禄之時，大運又在火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"分野為吉㑹。或遇太嵗是壬癸，或為衝刑，或為破害，是比肩而爭競也。如此者，防稱意中失意，主灾禍也。如不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":133,"lineType":2,"content":"是壬癸嵗，是亥子丑亦同。如當生嵗時中有戊巳重者為有救。人疲者人元疲乏也。馬劣者所合之辰馬弱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":135,"lineType":2,"content":"假令甲午生人，運行西方，申酉戌者是也。午為人元屬火，到西方死絶之地，是人元疲乏也。甲以巳為財，午内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"有巳土，巳土到西方，亦自衰敗，是劣弱也。猶託財旺之鄉者，午雖疲乏，猶賴西方金旺為財，已雖劣弱，秋金懐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸，亦可與巳破鬼生財也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃財旺禄衰，建馬何避衝掩。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575458344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗臨尚","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575474728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"不為灾，年登故宜獲福，","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575474728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"與前意同而理異也。如丙午人運至西方，財雖旺而祿衰，下元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511589924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":145,"lineType":2,"content":"建馬為助，言辛酉中有辛合丙也。則不畏衝掩也。掩者，伏滯也，如伏吟之𩔖。衝者，衝擊也，如反吟之𩔖。既是支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":147,"lineType":2,"content":"元，人元有財，財且旺而禄衰者，猶可以扶持。縱嵗運在掩伏衝擊者，亦無害事。此與中下興隆不殊。前説財運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"掩衝，此論嵗臨運位，亦未可便言凶咎。太嵗為造化之主，百煞之尊，來臨壓運，多凶少吉。若於三元內外五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"官印有用者，亦可以利見大人而成吉㑹。若三元内外財帛有用者，亦可以因貴人而發財帛也。且如生日是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":153,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，太嵗是庚午，運是戊午，此年嵗運之臨，亦為吉㑹也。次年交辛未，其氣不殊，官印財帛有用，則固宜獲福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉生逢小吉，反壽長年。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575474728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"天剛運至天魁，寄生續壽。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575491112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"丑為大吉，未為小吉。如癸未日生人行丑運，或丁丑日生人行未運，不得謂之反吟，皆謂之生氣。且癸水受氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"於巳，而成形於未，丁火受氣於亥，而成形在丑，故曰生逢。如壬課發用，丁課在未，而癸在丑，亦此意也。丑未為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511606308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":163,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽之中㑹，天一貴人所臨，主本與運逢之則有長年之壽也。辰為天罡。如庚戌生人行辰運，或甲辰生人行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"戍運，不得謂之反吟也。且庚金受氣於寅，而成形於辰，甲木受氣於申，而成形於戌，皆是生氣。鬼谷子曰罡中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"有乙，魁裏伏辛是也。前云生逢，後曰寄生，義不殊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575507496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"太衝臨昴胃之鄉，人元有害。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575523880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":169,"lineType":2,"content":"從魁，酉也。蒼龍，辰也。如酉日生人運至辰者是也。酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":171,"lineType":2,"content":"中有辛金，辰有乙木，金尅木為財，故曰財自天來，是用攴内天元為財也。太衝者，卯也。昴胃者，酉也。胃土雉，昴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":173,"lineType":2,"content":"日雞，有二宿在酉也。如卯日生，人運至酉者是也。卯，木也。酉，金也。金尅木而反相刑，支作人元是也，故曰有害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"害者，是七煞也。不獨衝刑尅制言之，亦是偏隂偏陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"金禄窮於正首，庚重辛輕；","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575540264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"木人困於金鄉，寅深卯淺。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575540264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"金絶在寅，庚受氣在寅。假如庚日生寅時者，多貴。金以火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511622692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":181,"lineType":2,"content":"為官，寅為火長生，是官長生也。又不尅上，火在寅中，金生寅上。賦云金禄窮於正首。成鑑云：受氣推尋，胎月須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"深。辛到卯位，二月節是辛金之胎也。甲在申，以金為官印，申乃金臨官。乙在酉，乃帝王也。賦云木人困於金鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"妙在識其通𠮓，拙説猶神；巫瞽昧於調絃，難希律吕。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575556648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人命中貴賤得失，妙處於四柱日時之中，要後人識其通𠮓者言之。然其辭雖拙，而妙應如神。設若不遇明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":189,"lineType":2,"content":"師，道聽塗説，巧言偽辭，焉能中理？如無日者之調絃，又豈能明於律吕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛臨於甲乙，君","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575573032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"子可以求官。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575573032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"北人運行南方，貨易獲其厚利。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575589416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"假令辛見甲，辛尅甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":193,"lineType":2,"content":"甲中生出丙火，丙與辛合，辛見官印。然不見火而見甲，甲乃丙之母，火之根也。須生日是辛日，嵗月時内有木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":195,"lineType":2,"content":"以辛尅甲，則甲中有火也。若年月時中支干內有水，則辛無官也。壬寅或别位帯將亥子辰水來，即木濕也。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511639076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":199,"lineType":2,"content":"木濕則無官，源濁伏吟是也。如見庚合，庚尅木，乙木生丁火，丁乃庚之官印。若癸卯嵗月時上有水，則乙木濕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":201,"lineType":2,"content":"而尅之，無煙也。只是金見木為財，有財而無官，金木皆不能成器。賦云金木未能成器，聽哀樂以難名也。是火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":203,"lineType":2,"content":"主禮，有禮則有君子，有君子則有官印也。無禮則小人也，無官則不貴也。賦云源濁伏吟，惆悵於歇官之地。寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"卯乃火生之地，是木而無火，故惆悵也。又與聞喜不喜同矣。其餘五行倣此，亦用生日支干為主。此論庚辛日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"生人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"聞朝歡而旋泣，為盛火之炎陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575605800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"尅禍福之賒遥，則","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575622184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"多因於水土。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575622184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"自從魁抵蒼龍之宿巳下，不獨運中灾福，而又明相濟而為得失，在學人可深求之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"也。聞朝歡而旋泣者，言火星髙明而好炎上也。明萬物者，莫盛乎火，故云為盛火之炎陽。鬼谷子曰：木火性本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":213,"lineType":2,"content":"上，尅禍福之賒遥。賒者，逺也。人遥者，逺之甚也。此言水土之性，沉伏而趍下也，故云多因水土。鬼谷子曰：水土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511655460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"性本下。正此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"金木未能成器，聽哀樂以難名。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575638568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"似木盛而花","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575654952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"繁，狀密雲而不雨。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575654952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"言金者則尚木，金得用而木乃成，是以剛濟柔也。言木者能尚金，木成器","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"而金得著，仁者必有勇也。若有金而無木，勇而無禮則亂。有木而無金，則庚辛虧而義寡。金者，西方之器也，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":223,"lineType":2,"content":"哀。木者，東方之物也，主樂。樂而不淫者，木遇金也。哀而不傷者，金得木也。凡此者，皆大人之命也。若明水火之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"歸中，用乎金木之間隔，由是哀樂不能動其心，乃方外難名之人也。人命有偏隂偏陽之命。似木盛而花繁者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":227,"lineType":2,"content":"偏陽之謂也。是五行逐末趨時，知進而不知退也。狀密雲而不雨者，偏隂之謂也。如此者，豈能有濟物之功哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"大率人命須要五行制尅，隂陽兩停，則為應格之命。故下文云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"乘軒衣冕，金火何多？","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575671336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"位","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575687720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"劣班𤰞，隂陽不定。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575687720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"前論水火，以相濟而成慶，次論金為木官鄉。是知水貴升，火貴降。火要濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511671844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"柔為剛，金要損剛益柔，則互用而為慶。其間獨有金剛火强，不可不知也。故賦云：乘軒衣冕者，皆君子之器也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":237,"lineType":2,"content":"亦須要金火兩停者能之。金，至堅之物也，非盛火則不能𠮓其質。火，至暴之物也，非鋭金則無以顯諸用。金火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":239,"lineType":2,"content":"兩存，則有鑄印之象，皆大人之事也。或火多而金少，或金多而火寡，皆為凶暴之命也。金旺於西方，火旺於南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"方，各恃其勢，則為自刑之刑。如此之命，雖日時有用，終歸於位劣班𤰞而已，非純和之氣也，是隂陽不能得定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":243,"lineType":2,"content":"分故也。火，陽也；金，隂也。既隂陽兩偏，則貴賤髙𤰞無所定著也。况有金而無火，有火而無金者，皆為凶徒之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"所以龍吟虎嘯，風雨助其休祥，火勢將興，故先煙而後","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575704104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"熖。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575704104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":247,"lineType":2,"content":"易曰：雲從龍，風從虎。此自然之理也，亦是隂陽洽合，五行唱和之義。火勢將興，故先煙而後熖者，此亦明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽氣順而有次序也。此與其為氣也不殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"每見凶中有吉，吉乃先凶，吉中","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575720488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511688228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"有凶，凶為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575720488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":253,"lineType":2,"content":"此復明氣順之理也。屈伸寒暑，莫不有道焉。且如前論，從魁抵蒼龍之宿，言財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"自天來者，吉也，是酉中辛尅辰中乙木為財也。辰乃水鄉，復能奪辛金之官，論財却不闕而失官也，故凶。太衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"臨昴胃之鄉，人元有害者，凶也。却木用金為官印，則不背官祿，凶中反吉也。賦意始於説運，次議五行，五行之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"後，再詳言之。每見凶中有吉，吉乃先凶，吉中有凶，凶為吉兆。又如火人行水運，則是七煞凶也，或用水為官吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":261,"lineType":2,"content":"也。水人行巳午運，南方獲利，為財吉也，却下有戊已七煞凶也。如此極多，要後人深造之以根本取最重者言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":263,"lineType":2,"content":"之為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"禍旬向末，言福可以迎推。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575736872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"纔入衰鄉，論灾宜其逆","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575753256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"課。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575753256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"男迎女送，否泰交居，隂陽二氣，逆順折除。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575769640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"如見在凶運，十年終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"滿，前交吉運者，若當生年月氣深，或行年太嵗扶助，向禄臨財者，更不須直待交吉運，只在此運，便可發福之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511704612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"慶，是可迎祥而推之也。纔入衰鄉，人命久歴福地，方交背禄財絶之運，固難言其吉，然未可便言凶也，是論灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":273,"lineType":2,"content":"宜逆課也，是知福深而禍淺也。更或行年太嵗，五行三命，别位有用而來朝運，與生日扶同者，宜其逆課也。更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"有當生節氣淺深之論，不可不知也。故下文有云男迎女送者，陽男隂女運順行也。然一運十年，更分前後，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"年之中，凡入吉運，得節氣深。男迎者，前五年發福，是謂男迎也。女送者，後五年方吉也，故謂之女送。此與隂男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"陽女不殊。大運者，氣之所主也。謂如甲子日生人，九月下旬生陽命男，四嵗運，二十五嵗交丑運，是甲禄庫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":281,"lineType":2,"content":"運，九月氣深，發福在五年也。否泰交居也。此論小運之氣也。寅為三陽，化起泰卦，故小運起丙寅。申為三隂，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":283,"lineType":2,"content":"處否卦，女小運起壬申。此隂陽否泰交居，各分逆順。折除者，大運三日為一年，小運一年移一宫，積十三年，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"運併度一周天，此合閏餘之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"占其金木之內，顯於方所分野，標其","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575786024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511720996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"南北之間，恐不利於往來。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575786024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬之內，於年中而問干。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575802408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575818792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗之中，求月中而問日。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575818792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"向三避五，指方面以窮通。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575835176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"審吉","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575851560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"量凶，述嵗中之否泰。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575851560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":293,"lineType":2,"content":"又有占其金木之内，顯其方所分野。占，音占去聲。入著當生嵗月日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"時所，占後運逢金木方所分野，則顯其發福也。且如木用金為官印，陽命男運出未入申，隂命男運出亥入戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"是向禄臨財於金木分野之際也。又如金用木為財，陽命男運出丑入寅，隂命男運出巳入辰，是向禄臨財在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"木火方所之中也。更加之以太嵗、月令氣候扶同而言之，則尤妙。標，對本，又有標凖之義，則是命基本也。南者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"顯明而往也。北者，歸向而來也。此言運氣出入動静，或吉或凶，不可輕言也。或遇交運之年，不可輕舉也。凡言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"命運動靜出處，當入神詳謹而言之。一失其源，則無所利也。自此以後，論嵗中禍福，故下文云云。一旬之内，於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511737380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"年中而問干者，是月中求日也。一嵗之中，求月中而問日者，是年中求月也。向三背五者，是嵗中求吉利方所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":309,"lineType":2,"content":"也。凡坐作進退，向吉背凶，莫大於此矣。一旬，十日也。年中者，生日也。凡在一月之中、一旬之內，將生日天元配","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"合而言之，則知其日中休祥也，是立生日以為主也。　一嵗之中者，取月令以生元配合而言之，則知其月中休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":313,"lineType":2,"content":"咎也。且如人生得地，而須太嵗為尊，是一嵗之中求生月帶禄或官印，元有元無，是月中而問日也。此㸔命總","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"法也。又以行年嵗運言之，且如壬寅日生人，遇辛未嵗，是謂宅墓。壬用巳為官印嵗位，未中有巳，此年宜利見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"大人；壬用丁為財帛，未中有丁，此年因貴人獲財利。或問曰：財官在嵗中，甚月日得之？荅曰：自巳至戌，吉無不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":319,"lineType":2,"content":"利。此亦是嵗中問日，他准此。或動静出處者，即向行年天醫、福徳、生氣三方為言，其餘五鬼不可往也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575867944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"癸乃秋生而冬旺，亥子同途。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575867944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙乃夏死而春榮，寅卯","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575884328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511753764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"一𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575884328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"乍舉求勝，無非禄馬同鄉。始論壬癸亥子，次論甲乙寅卯。𤰞辱尊榮，故貴居强。坐實此言水數一，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"生木，木生火，故受之於丙寅丁卯，以言其有序也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，秋天宜以保扶。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575900712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575917096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"巳戊辰，度乾宫而脱厄。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575917096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"火者，南方之氣也，萬物亨㑹之方。物盛且極，不可不戒。故云秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"天宜以保持也。金者，西方之氣也，乃藏萬物之辰。太上曰萬物芸芸，各歸其根是也。保持者，土也，能持載萬物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"藉之以為生者也。四象不可無土，故下文云巳巳戊辰，度乾宫而脫厄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病，逢生得","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575933480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"生，旺相峥嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575933480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚滅絶，論其眷屬，憂其死絶。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575949864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":335,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬寅人，要丙丁為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"妻財，戊巳為官印，庚為壬之母，乙為壬之子。又如大運到火旺處，父旺；庚旺處，母旺。若運在衰病處，逐類而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":339,"lineType":2,"content":"之。若運到墓絶之上，更逢七殺倂者，是乃危疑而凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"墓在鬼中，危疑者甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575966248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"足下","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575982632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511770148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"臨䘮，面前可見。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575982632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"庫絶位逢鬼，或流年嵗命前後一辰也。若人生時辰生日犯之，則主早尅父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":345,"lineType":2,"content":"也。及有生離逺地，或生日生時之干，來尅太嵗下者，尤凶。面前可見者，言其為凶運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"憑隂察其陽","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575999016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，嵗星莫犯於孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826575999016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"恃陽鑒以隂灾，天年忌逢於寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576015400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"隂以陽為對，陽以隂為耦。如説陽卦多隂，隂卦多陽，其理一也。既知其隂，則陽亦可知也。隂既得時而有立，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":351,"lineType":2,"content":"陽禍可知矣。故曰憑隂察其陽禍也。嵗星者，太嵗也，不可在孤神之上。假令寅卯辰人遇太嵗在巳是也。寅人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":353,"lineType":2,"content":"勾絞，卯人䘮弔，辰人謂之控神殺，又謂之邀神殺，主阻礙抑塞。天年者，亦太嵗也，不可在寡宿之上。又如寅卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"辰人遇太嵗在丑是也。辰人勾絞，卯人䘮弔，寅人謂之窺神殺，又謂迫神殺，主人窺竊逼廹䧟害。其或三元刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"戰，嵗運不和，或是五行財禄為害之年，則尤為凶甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"先論二氣，次課延生。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576031784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"父病推","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576048168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511786532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"其子禄，妻灾課以夫年。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576048168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":361,"lineType":2,"content":"二氣者，隂陽也。延生者，命運也。分别隂陽，既分命運，自然響應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":363,"lineType":2,"content":"父病推其子祿，妻灾課以夫年。亦是明隂陽進退之象也。假令庚辰人十月生，庚金病在亥，是父母病也。庚生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"壬為子，壬禄在亥，是子有禄也。妻灾課以夫年者，庚以乙為妻，大運到巳，乙木敗於巳，是妻灾也。而庚金復得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"延年，是妻灾課以夫年。此大槩之論也。假令丙戍日生人，下取辛為妻年，辛生癸為子，却行亥子運，丙到亥子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":370,"lineType":2,"content":"則衰病，而癸禄厚也。如壬癸日生人，行亥子運，則父母灾病，或丁憂也。又丙以辛為妻，運行寅卯，辛金絶於寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":372,"lineType":2,"content":"卯，則妻灾也。却丙火逢生，是夫却得延年也。如丙丁日生，運行寅卯者，則灾，或䘮偶也。其餘准此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576064552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"元吉，禍遲可以延推。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576064552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"始末皆凶，灾忽來而迅速。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576080936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":374,"lineType":2,"content":"前論隂陽之始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"終，此説人命有吉凶。如命内天元、人元、支元，内外嵗月時中值貴禄不居休敗，或值行年太嵗，運同乖危之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511802916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":380,"lineType":2,"content":"雖是凶運，然亦可推禍以遲延也。夫何故？以根基主本，三元元吉故也。若三元內外，雖有禄馬貴氣，却八字中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":382,"lineType":2,"content":"衝刑破害，不唯有貴而不貴，又終為凶人之命也。如遇吉運，則防因福生禍，則灾忽來而迅速故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576097320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"受殺，落梁塵以呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576097320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮弔臨人，變宫商為薤露。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576113704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":384,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗命前後五辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":386,"lineType":2,"content":"為宅墓，人生日時與嵗運，不宜逢之受殺也。如見丙丁是騰蛇，見戊巳即是勾陳，見庚辛即是白虎，見壬癸即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":388,"lineType":2,"content":"是𤣥武，見甲乙即是青龍。㸔類而言之，故云受殺。凡遇此者，皆主家宅隂小，財畜不和。嵗命前後二辰為䘮弔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":390,"lineType":2,"content":"如人嵗運日時犯之，主孝服哭泣，輕者外服逺親，不利家宅，骨肉離異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"干推兩重，防灾於","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576130088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"元首之間；支折三輕，慎禍於股肱之內。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576130088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"下元一氣，周居","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576146472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"去住之期。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576146472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":394,"lineType":2,"content":"假令壬寅人逢戊為太嵗，戊為月建者，兩戊尅壬，則為干推兩重。遇之者，為元首頭目之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511819300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":398,"lineType":2,"content":"灾。輕者，為股肱之患也。此論未詳。此賦意論三元動静之理，物我輕重之别，四時𠮓通之義。如壬寅人，壬為天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":400,"lineType":2,"content":"元，為首，為尊長，見戊謂之七煞。如遇戊為太嵗，為尊長，太嵗則大人尊長之事，是以太嵗為尊，月建為𤰞也。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":402,"lineType":2,"content":"謂支干推也。推則有剛柔相推之義。兩重者，視壬與戊兩干勢孰重。戊重則尅壬，防有尊長不喜，不利見大人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":404,"lineType":2,"content":"壬重見戊不我尅，唯人事而巳，或頭目作疾，此太嵗之事也。與月建相尅者輕，戊重則僚友不和，壬重則小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":406,"lineType":2,"content":"為害，或腰膝作疾。更月支下三合，如或有救，則為灾輕也。折有𠮓義，故云支折三輕，慎禍於股肱之内。此月建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":408,"lineType":2,"content":"之事也。上文論干祿支命，天元十干常動，地元十二支常静。復言下元一氣者，支也，以壬為天元，如四柱别有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":410,"lineType":2,"content":"丁，或有巳，則壬應而合之，或為官印，或為財帛，是干未常不動也。支者，雖遇巳時，周流往還𠮓易，而支未常不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":412,"lineType":2,"content":"静也。周者，循𤨔也。居者，安居也。期者，如期限之期。去住者，氣也。此言四時周流循環，無有終始，無有窮極，而下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511835684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":416,"lineType":2,"content":"元之辰，未嘗不善守其期限也，只可以三合取之。或干尅太嵗者，㸔兩干勢力輕重而言之，或為尊長頭目之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":418,"lineType":2,"content":"灾，或在僚友左右之嫉，此與輕重較量不殊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"仁而不仁，慮傷伐於戊巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576162856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"至於","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576179240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"寢食侍衛，物有鬼物，人有鬼人，逢之為灾，去之為福。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576179240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":420,"lineType":2,"content":"仁者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":422,"lineType":2,"content":"是甲乙木也，在五常為仁。今反言不仁者，以其尅伐乎土也。如甲見巳則為仁，乙見戊則為仁，以其隂陽造化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":424,"lineType":2,"content":"五物代之，以為生也。若甲見戊，乙見巳，偏隂偏陽，萬物危脆，則五行為不仁也。賦中引甲乙戊巳為例，其餘五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":426,"lineType":2,"content":"行則可以例求焉。侍衛者，是人養生之至近也。又云寢食者，則又近。侍衛者，至親也。寢食，奉養也。此二者，慎不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":428,"lineType":2,"content":"可輕忽也。夫物中有鬼物，人中有鬼人者，言吉凶之𠮓，遷及逺近，速之甚也。以㸔命言之，且如六戊日生人，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":430,"lineType":2,"content":"乙為官印。六巳日生人，用甲為官印。木與土比和，隂與陽唱和，則為仁也。如戊見甲，巳見乙，則仁而不仁也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511852068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":434,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊見甲為不仁，或嵗月時中見庚辛，則為仁矣。或見巳亦為仁矣。且戊見甲亦為仁者，謂甲巳合已侍衛甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":436,"lineType":2,"content":"也。見庚則為仁者，謂戊食庚者，逢之為灾，則是戊不逢庚，已被甲來尅制，與七殺同論。去之為福者，如戊見甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":438,"lineType":2,"content":"則嵗月時中有庚戊巳求救助，則為福也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"就中裸形夾殺，魄往酆都。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576195624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576212008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"犯有傷，䰟歸岱嶺。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576212008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":440,"lineType":2,"content":"裸形者，五行沐浴也。如人本音沐浴，大運逢之者灾。水土人運在酉，木人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":442,"lineType":2,"content":"運在子，火人運在卯，金人運在午，鬼谷子謂之波浪限也。夾殺者，元辰七殺也。如人運在沐浴之上，與太嵗倂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":444,"lineType":2,"content":"者，灾重。或當生嵗時元有傷犯之辰，則䰟歸岱嶺，魄往酆都，此至凶名也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃行來出入，抵","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576228392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"犯凶方，嫁娶修營，路登黄黒。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576228392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":446,"lineType":2,"content":"出入者，言運出運入之異也。如壬癸日生人，運行在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":448,"lineType":2,"content":"戍，為土火之聚，則為吉運。運交亥，亥為火之絶，此為凶運。乃是行來出入，抵犯凶方。我尅者，為之妻財，妻財在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511868452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":452,"lineType":2,"content":"旺鄉，則為之娶。尅我者，為官鬼，又為天官，喜在長生財旺之地。賦意總説要扶同五行，體用隂陽。或運來尅命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":454,"lineType":2,"content":"而為官貴之鄉，日尅運宫，乃是發財之地。皆以生月起建，陽男隂女則順，隂男陽女則逆。如運到黄道，凡百皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":456,"lineType":2,"content":"利；運至黑道，凡百抑塞。凡人行為動作，進退向背，莫不本乎隂陽，體合運氣，吉凶俱不能逃也。故云嫁娶修營，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":458,"lineType":2,"content":"路登黄黑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"灾福在嵗年之位內，發覺由日時之擊揚。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576244776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"五神相","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576261160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，三生定命。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576261160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"每見貴人食禄，無非禄馬之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576277544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"源濁伏吟，","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576293928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"惆悵歇宫之地。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576293928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":462,"lineType":2,"content":"凡説嵗中休祥，專責日時與太嵗相尅，刑害衝破。言之生日為妻，時為子，日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":464,"lineType":2,"content":"與太嵗和合，及財官有用，無諸壊者，依事𩔖而言之。如太嵗與日時相刑，或六合三合中有元辰七殺者凶，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":466,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔𩔖而言之。故下文云不過是五神相尅，三生定命也。每見貴人食禄，無非禄馬之鄉。源濁伏吟，惆悵歇宫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511884836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":470,"lineType":2,"content":"地。上卷有例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"狂横起於勾絞，禍敗發於元亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576310312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓同處，恐少","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576326696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"樂而多憂。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576326696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"萬里回還，乃是三歸之地。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576343080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗命前三辰為勾，後三辰為絞，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":474,"lineType":2,"content":"在元命日時二運之上遇之者，主非灾横禍。更或與元辰七殺倂者，尤凶。嵗命前後五辰為宅墓，如戊子生遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未太嵗者是也。亦須未子日上及時上本有，或大運同宫者則重。凡遇此者，不利隂小家宅也。此言大運在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"十二辰之間，順逆囘環在三元本禄本財終須之地，遇此者則為優安之福厚，更晚年遇財禄歸聚之處，則尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":480,"lineType":2,"content":"有所長也。根本元無者，無所長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"四殺之父，多生五鬼之男。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576359464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"六害之徒，","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576375848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"命有七傷之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576375848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未為四方之末季，為五行之庫墓。言辰戌丑未中藏納五行死墓之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":484,"lineType":2,"content":"如人運限逢之，生幽憂之疾，淹延之厄，如父子之相承，卒難不能救解。破命者謂之害，如人運限逢之，皆主眷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511901220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"屬離合，人情反覆。或更六害中逢七殺尅我者凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"眷屬情同水火，相逢於沐浴","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576392232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉，骨肉中道分離，孤宿尤嫌隔角。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576392232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":490,"lineType":2,"content":"水隂火陽，相合而為既濟，相資而為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":492,"lineType":2,"content":"仇讐，言其反覆多𠮓，或情通自乖而反合，或情𠮓自合而反乖，故曰情同水火也。義欲和而同、久而逺者，必須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":494,"lineType":2,"content":"在五行沐浴之時。五行休敗，如人情處患難之時，未有不情同者也。以㸔命言之，如丙寅、丁夘，貴在猪雞；壬戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥，貴於蛇兎。此無它，大率五行貴在於衰敗之中，人情要處乎淡泊之際也。凡命運隔角者，主中道骨肉有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":498,"lineType":2,"content":"離異之事。隔者，如夘日丑時，丑日卯時。鬼谷子曰：枉多隔角。餘可例求焉。丑者，北方之氣也。卯者，東方之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":500,"lineType":2,"content":"其趣不同，遇之者中道分離也。嫌疑孤神者，殺也。遇多孤立而未嫌，甚言隔角之重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"須要明其","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576408616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"神殺，輕重較量。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576408616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"身尅殺而尚輕，殺尅身而尤重。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576425000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":502,"lineType":2,"content":"神殺者，官印、禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511917604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":506,"lineType":2,"content":"馬，貴賤之别名也。如前説，上尅下則不貴，下尅上即貴，意義不殊。殺尅身者是官來尅我者，是下尅上者也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":508,"lineType":2,"content":"身尅殺，是我尅官，即不貴也。故賦曰：須要明其神殺。神譬官印，殺比財帛。但官財是尅我，則為之殺尅身。我尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":510,"lineType":2,"content":"官財，則為之身尅殺。此明貴賤之本也。更詳其輕重，較量而言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"至於循𤨔八卦，因河","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576441384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"洛以遺文，畧之定為一端，究之飜成萬緒。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576441384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":512,"lineType":2,"content":"易曰：河出圖，洛出書，聖人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":514,"lineType":2,"content":"則之，以教後世。循𤨔於四時之中，布八卦於四維之内，而成一嵗之功。亘古窮今，無有終窮者，道也。道分為隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":516,"lineType":2,"content":"陽，而人處乎其中，則吉凶悔吝存焉。是以動静屈伸，體天法地，莫不由乎命也。故下文云：一端者，道降而為一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":518,"lineType":2,"content":"也。二三數六，又三而成九，又九九而成八十　一數。自此以後，繞繞萬緒，莫能紀極。以㸔命言之，不過五神相尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":520,"lineType":2,"content":"三生定命，一也。其氣有淺深者，運有向背，福有厚薄，壽有長短，要後人深求之，則得古人之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"若值","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576457768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511933988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"攀鞍踐禄，逢之則佩印乘軒；馬劣財微，遇之則流而不","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576457768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"返。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576457768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":526,"lineType":2,"content":"攀鞍踐祿者，乃貴人之美稱也。馬劣財微者，乃衆人所𢙣也。凡人鎡基嵗月帶禄者，日時得地運，順禄而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"向官鄉，則佩印乘軒，固不難矣。此言根本元有官禄，運更向而不背者也。馬劣財微者，其財必微。言人命嵗月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"本無祖財，及無父母財，雖日時得地，後運遇財絶之鄉，即財帛散，如水東流，往而不返，此明根本元無者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"占除望拜，甲午以四八為期。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576474152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"口舌文書，巳亥慎三十有","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576490536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"二。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576490536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":534,"lineType":2,"content":"前文説有禄者吉，無財者凶，此説元無禄者，遇有財禄運，則崇遷而榮，無官者遇鬼則退職也。如甲午人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"下有丁巳，甲以已為財，而無官印。占除望拜，四八為期者，四月為金長生，甲以金為官印，四月是官長生，八月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":538,"lineType":2,"content":"是金帝旺。如甲乙日生人，或問食禄在㡬時，須言在四月八月為食禄之期也。口舌文書，已亥慎三十有二者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511950372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":542,"lineType":2,"content":"言已亥日生人，亥中有木長生，元有官禄也。或運行巳，或到酉者，則為口舌文書。口舌見訟事，文書則口章。巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":544,"lineType":2,"content":"用甲為官印，已上木病，酉上木絶，三十二者，亦是四八之數也。此言戊巳日生人，如遇已或到酉運，則宜退身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":546,"lineType":2,"content":"而避位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相伴，揺動遷移，夾殺持邱，親姻哭送。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576506920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"𠔥須詳","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576523304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"其操執，觀厥秉持。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576523304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"厚薄論其骨狀，成器藉於心源。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576539688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"木氣","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576556072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"盛而仁昌，庚辛虧而義寡。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576556072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":550,"lineType":2,"content":"善惡者，吉凶也。相伴者，不偏也。如人運行至此，吉凶争勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":552,"lineType":2,"content":"之年，皆主身心不寧，動揺遷改，在隂陽則有所忌。易曰：吉凶悔吝，生乎動也。動則多凶，宜守慎詳約以處之乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":554,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。夾殺持邱者，如人運命遇太嵗月建大運，與元辰、七殺併臨於五行墓絶之位者，此年慎不可弔喪問病也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":556,"lineType":2,"content":"如賦云物有鬼物，人有鬼人，逢之為凶，去之為福是也。如遇此年，尤宜慎處，向吉背凶，則無不利矣。前説嵗運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511966756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"休祥，復明根本作用也。且如木人秋生，木被金尅，則為性有操執也。甲申、乙酉、乙巳、乙丑、甲戌生人，不背官禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":562,"lineType":2,"content":"也。或生於三春九夏季，木氣盛時，秉受旺氣，有所執持也，故云觀厥秉持。又須生時在西北方，金土之中，或大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":564,"lineType":2,"content":"運到金土分野，則有官印長逺。若或甲申、乙酉、乙巳、乙丑、甲戌日生人，生於秋三月，或三春夏季，不背官祿，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"所執持，才能操執。却嵗月時居火木盛時，火木旺地，或行運在東南，有丙丁火旺，早年雖發福，晚年蕭條也。賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":568,"lineType":2,"content":"意之要言，令後人觀五行造化向背而詳言之。如前論甲申、乙酉、乙巳、乙丑、甲戌者，雖居官印之位，然物有厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":570,"lineType":2,"content":"薄之不齊，則吉凶修短之有異。何以言之？木旺則天元厚，天元厚則有操持，有操持則權重也。金旺則禄厚，祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":572,"lineType":2,"content":"厚則官重，官重則有秉持也。若金木之氣俱薄，則官禄何可長也？故曰厚薄論其骨狀是也。成器藉於心源者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":574,"lineType":2,"content":"謂如金若不遇木，須用火為官印也。且如庚辛日生人，要在三春九夏，則財官兩美也，所云乘軒衣冕，金火何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511983140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":578,"lineType":2,"content":"多是也。心源者，離宫也，屬火，金得火乃成器也。前説木遇金為操持，次論金遇火而成器，皆因五行相尅而成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":580,"lineType":2,"content":"造化。更㸔金火之器不偏運，向禄而不背，則為福長久也。又下文云：木，仁也；金，義也。木盛而逢金，則剛柔得中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":582,"lineType":2,"content":"如由豫之盍簪，有以利天下，則仁而昌。庚辛履而逢火，似井泥之而不食，不能廣濟，則寡於義。此又何疑焉？賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":584,"lineType":2,"content":"云：兼須詳其操執，觀厥秉持者，以言其金木之體；厚薄論其骨狀成器藉於心源者，以言其金火之才。各得其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":586,"lineType":2,"content":"宜，則為好命。至於金木氣偏，木氣盛而仁昌，庚辛虧而義寡者，是財用不相宜。金木各不仁，則凶。悔吝從之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜加而有喜；疑其大器，福星臨而禍發，必表凶人。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576572456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":588,"lineType":2,"content":"詳註","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":590,"lineType":2,"content":"見上卷。初至衰鄉，猶披尠福。内更不重載。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"處定求動，尅未進而難遷；居安問","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576588840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"危，可凶中而卜吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576588840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":592,"lineType":2,"content":"此卷未總言其妙旨也。處定者，凡言人命用法，處者，欲定其貴賤也。貴賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845511999524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"既明，故曰處定也。求動者，人命雖見官印財帛而不貴富者，宜於處定之中，復求其𠮓動也。既見其貴中未貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":598,"lineType":2,"content":"財中未財，則當尅未進而難遷也。未進者，未當升進。難遷者，難為遷移也。此與上文云息一氣以凝神，消五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":600,"lineType":2,"content":"而通道之義不殊。居安者，如是貴命，見行官禄，所向集福之運，以為安也。問危者，未可便言終吉，况前云吉中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":602,"lineType":2,"content":"有凶，當於嵗月時申扶合行年太嵗三合三㑹，問危疑神殺，叅詳而言之。如見有危疑之神，則必有危疑之事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":604,"lineType":2,"content":"則當懲戒積善以禳之，則凶中復吉矣。如易説憂悔吝者，存乎介者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"貴而忘賤，灾自奢","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576605224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576605224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"迷而不返，禍從惑起。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576621608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":606,"lineType":2,"content":"貴而忘賤，是後人不明賤意，引大道之妙，而執方守隅，見貴命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":608,"lineType":2,"content":"貴而言貴，不知貴中有賤。或始貴而終賤者，則灾自奢生，與賒同一其源，則妙理賒自逺也。此説見貴忘賤之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":610,"lineType":2,"content":"誤也。其或有不遇至人，不明道理者，執迷而見，寡陋偏學，滋蔓偏求，理無所出者，則是禍從惑起者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"殊","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576637992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845512015908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"常易舊，變處為萌，福善禍淫，吉凶異兆。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576637992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":614,"lineType":2,"content":"殊常者，知𠮓也；易舊者，善通也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":616,"lineType":2,"content":"𠮓處為萌者，知其幽微也。曽遇明師，必通道理者，誠有如易所謂茍非其人，道不虚行是也。古人為道者，皓首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"窮經，專心致志，惟恐失於妙道。雖行坐服食，未嘗心不在五行之中，則能知幽妙有殊常易舊，變處為萌，是知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":620,"lineType":2,"content":"大道福善而禍淫，故君子修身以俟命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"至於公明、季主，尚無變識之文；景","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576654376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"純、仲舒，不載比形之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576654376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":622,"lineType":2,"content":"易曰：知𠮓化之道者，其知神之所為乎！知進退存亡之道者，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":624,"lineType":2,"content":"唯聖人乎！以此究之，隂陽之道，難終又難窮也。故賦云：管公明、董仲舒、郭景純、司馬季主者，皆王佐之才，博通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":626,"lineType":2,"content":"經史，洞達隂陽，遺文教於後世，可謂賢矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其往聖，鑒以前賢，或指事以陳","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576670760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"謀，或約文而切理。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576670760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"多或少剩，二義難精。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576687144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"今者叅詳得失，","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576703528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7638804845512032292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"補綴遺蹤，窺為心鑑，永掛清臺，引列終編，千希得一。","logicSentenceId":"7678983826576703528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":632,"lineType":2,"content":"然則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":634,"lineType":2,"content":"致君澤民於當時，則不能全身逺害也。或指事以陳謀，約文而切理者有之矣。珞琭萃衆妙之説，將少者補其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":636,"lineType":2,"content":"詳博，剩者遺其繁蕪，故云補綴遺蹤。窺者，所見者小也。心鑑，言自謙心有所見甚少也。引列終編者，是探索前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":638,"lineType":2,"content":"賢往聖盡善盡美之至道也。得之於心，則永掛清臺，善用者千希得一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1605/5/ref/1m1oet0zrgzrj/1-SK1605_figure_00
